nodes.description: Address of the current owner (Owned.owner), set to msg.sender in constructor and used by onlyOwner modifier.
Pending owner address awaiting acceptance via acceptOwnership (Owned.newOwner).
Public token symbol string, set to GOL in constructor.
Public token name string, set to GOGOLCOIN in constructor.
Public token decimals, set to 4 in constructor.
_totalSupply uint holding 295000000 * 10**decimals, returned by totalSupply().
Mapping(address=>uint) balances tracking every account token balance.
Nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) allowed storing ERC20 allowances.
SafeMath.safeAdd: c = a + b with require(c >= a) overflow guard.
SafeMath.safeSub: require(b <= a); c = a - b underflow guard.
SafeMath.safeMul: c = a * b with require(a == 0 || c / a == b) overflow guard.
SafeMath.safeDiv: require(b > 0); c = a / b division-by-zero guard.
Owned.transferOwnership, onlyOwner, sets newOwner pending owner.
Owned.acceptOwnership, requires msg.sender == newOwner, then transfers ownership and zeroes newOwner.
ERC20 totalSupply() view returning _totalSupply.
ERC20 balanceOf(address) view returning balances[tokenOwner].
ERC20 transfer: debits msg.sender via safeSub and credits 'to' via safeAdd, then emits Transfer.
ERC20 approve: writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval (no double-spend guard).
ERC20 transferFrom: debits balances[from], debits allowed[from][msg.sender] and credits 'to' using SafeMath helpers.
ERC20 allowance(address,address) view returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance then performs external call to spender.receiveApproval — state change before untrusted external call (reentrancy surface).
receive() external payable that unconditionally reverts, rejecting ETH.
onlyOwner rescue function performing an arbitrary external ERC20 call: IERC20(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens).
ApproveAndCallFallBack abstract external hook invoked by approveAndCall on the spender contract.
GOGOLCOIN constructor: sets symbol/name/decimals, mints _totalSupply to a hardcoded owner address and emits Transfer.
msg.sender — attacker-controllable caller address used for balance/allowance indexing and access checks.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed after allowance state update in approveAndCall.
External call IERC20(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) with an arbitrary caller-supplied token contract.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the account key for balances[msg.sender] inside transfer.
msg.sender indexes allowed[msg.sender][spender] in approve.
msg.sender indexes allowed[from][msg.sender] in transferFrom.
msg.sender indexes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and is forwarded to the external receiveApproval call in approveAndCall.
onlyOwner modifier on transferOwnership requires msg.sender == owner; caller identity gates the state change.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner, so caller identity controls ownership transfer.
onlyOwner modifier on transferAnyERC20Token gates the privileged external transfer with msg.sender.
Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing privileged role from caller input.
balances[msg.sender] is read and decreased via safeSub inside transfer.
transfer writes the updated balances[msg.sender] and balances[to] state values.
transfer delegates the sender balance decrement to safeSub, which enforces the underflow require.
transfer delegates the recipient balance increment to safeAdd, which enforces the overflow require.
transferFrom reads allowed[from][msg.sender] before decrementing it.
transferFrom writes the reduced allowance back into allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom uses safeSub for both balance and allowance decrements (arithmetic guards).
transferFrom uses safeAdd to credit the destination balance (arithmetic guard).
transferFrom reads balances[from] to validate and decrement the source balance.
transferFrom writes updated balances[from] and balances[to].
approve stores the granted amount in allowed[msg.sender][spender] with no double-spend check.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before performing the untrusted external callback.
approveAndCall invokes an external contract (spender.receiveApproval) after state mutation, enabling reentrancy.
The callee of the external receiveApproval call can re-enter approveAndCall before the transaction completes.
approveAndCall calls the ApproveAndCallFallBack.receiveApproval hook on the untrusted spender contract.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call into an attacker-supplied token contract, a callback/reentrancy surface.
The arbitrary external token call can re-enter the token contract's privileged function.
The caller-supplied tokenAddress determines the target contract of the external call.
The 'tokens' argument flows into the external IERC20.transfer call.
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender] and returns it.
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner] and returns it.
totalSupply returns the _totalSupply state variable.
Constructor writes the minted amount into _totalSupply.
Constructor mints balances[owner] = _totalSupply.
Constructor sets symbol = "GOL".
Constructor sets name = "GOGOLCOIN".
Constructor sets decimals = 4.
Owned constructor sets the owner privilege state variable from the deploying caller.
owner is read by the onlyOwner modifier guarding transferAnyERC20Token.
owner is read by the onlyOwner modifier guarding transferOwnership.
acceptOwnership emits OwnershipTransferred(owner, newOwner) and overwrites owner.
acceptOwnership assigns owner = newOwner, completing the privileged role handover.
transferOwnership writes the pending owner into the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal the newOwner state variable and clears it to address(0).
newOwner is the storage destination of transferOwnership which can be re-overwritten by the owner.
safeAdd writes the guarded addition result into local variable c.
safeSub writes the guarded subtraction result into local variable c.
safeMul writes the guarded multiplication result into local variable c.
safeDiv writes the guarded division result into local variable c.
Parameter a is an operand of the safeAdd addition.
Parameter b is an operand of the safeAdd addition.
Parameter a is an operand of the safeSub subtraction.
Parameter b is an operand of the safeSub subtraction and the require bound.
Parameter a is an operand of the safeMul multiplication.
Parameter b is an operand of the safeMul multiplication.
Parameter a is the dividend of the safeDiv division.
Parameter b is the divisor of the safeDiv division and is checked for zero.
The new owner address parameter flows into newOwner assignment.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
Recipient parameter 'to' indexes balances[to] and appears in the Transfer event.
Amount parameter 'tokens' is the arithmetic operand debited and credited in transfer.
spender parameter indexes allowed[msg.sender][spender] in approve.
tokens parameter is stored as the approved allowance in approve.
'from' parameter indexes balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender] in transferFrom.
'to' parameter receives the credited balance in transferFrom.
'tokens' parameter is the arithmetic operand for both balance and allowance decrements.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the allowance mapping.
spender parameter indexes the allowance mapping.
spender parameter determines the external contract that receives the callback.
tokens parameter is stored in allowed and forwarded to receiveApproval.
Opaque bytes data parameter is forwarded verbatim into the external call.
Attacker-controlled calldata is passed to the external receiveApproval invocation.
tokenAddress parameter selects the contract invoked by the privileged external call.
tokens parameter is the amount forwarded to the external ERC20 transfer.
balanceOf returns balances[tokenOwner] through the named return variable.
allowance returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender] through the named return variable.
Constructor assigns the hardcoded mint recipient to the local 'owner' variable.
The constructor's local 'owner' variable is not the state variable used to index balances when minting.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter a of safeAdd is a pure operand of the safeAdd function; it carries no independent security semantics.
Parameter b of safeAdd is a pure operand of the safeAdd function.
Parameter a of safeSub is a pure operand of the safeSub function.
Parameter b of safeSub is a pure operand of the safeSub function's underflow require.
Parameter a of safeMul is a pure operand of the safeMul function.
Parameter b of safeMul is a pure operand of the safeMul function.
Parameter a of safeDiv is a pure operand of the safeDiv function.
Parameter b of safeDiv is a pure operand of the safeDiv function's zero-check.
_newOwner only flows into transferOwnership's restricted state write and has no separate role.
tokenOwner is only a mapping key for balanceOf's read.
Recipient address is only a mapping key used by transfer.
Transfer amount is only an arithmetic operand handled by transfer and its SafeMath calls.
spender is only a mapping key for approve's allowance write.
Approved amount is only written into allowance state by approve.
Source address is only a mapping key for transferFrom's balance and allowance updates.
Destination address is only a mapping key credited by transferFrom.
Transfer amount is only a SafeMath operand inside transferFrom.
tokenOwner is only a mapping key for the allowance view.
spender is only a mapping key for the allowance view.
spender selects the untrusted callee of approveAndCall and is fully summarized by the external call.
tokens is only stored as allowance and forwarded to the external callback by approveAndCall.
Opaque data is passed through the external call performed by approveAndCall.
tokenAddress directly determines the target of the privileged external call represented by the unsafe operation.
tokens is the amount carried into the external ERC20 transfer unsafe operation.
Local c is just the return slot of safeAdd's guarded addition.
Local c is just the return slot of safeSub's guarded subtraction.
Local c is just the return slot of safeMul's guarded multiplication.
Local c is just the return slot of safeDiv's guarded division.
Named return 'balance' merely carries the value read by balanceOf.
Named return 'remaining' merely carries the allowance value read by allowance.
Constructor local 'owner' is a transient alias for the hardcoded mint recipient set in the constructor.
